    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];

        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

  @ public normal_behavior
  @ ensures \result == null ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < (A == null ? 0 : A.length); A[i] == A[i]); // no modification

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

               (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length; \result[i] != A[i] && \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == A[0].length));

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

        if (mat.length == 0) return true;

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

    //@ requires digits != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;

    //@   digits.length == 0 || (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@        (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)
    //@       )
    //@     ) &&
    //@     (digits.length % 2 == 0 || 
    //@       (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@     )
    //@   )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@   ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@    (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6)
        //@   );
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len / 2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

            return false;

public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 0 <= x < i && x < y < nVert; adjacencyMat[x][y] == adjacencyMat[y][x];
        //@ loop_writes i;

            //@ maintaining \forall int y; i + 1 <= y < j; adjacencyMat[i][y] == adjacencyMat[y][i];
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases nVert - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {

---

**Correction:**

The issue is that the loop invariants and maintaining clauses allow `j` to be equal to `m`, but the valid indices are from `0` to `m-1`. So, the loop invariants should ensure `j < m` rather than `j <= m`.

Similarly, for `i`, it is correct to have `i <= n` because the loop condition is `i < n`.

So the corrected code is:

    //@   (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1])
    //@ );

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x-1][y-1];

```java
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

Correction explanation:

The errors reported are:

1. "Incorrectly formed or terminated loop_invariant statement near here" at line with `//@ loop_invariant iBegin <= k && k <= iEnd;`

2. "Incorrectly formed or terminated loop_invariant statement near here" at line with `//@ loop_writes a[iBegin .. iEnd - 1];`

The problem is that JML expects loop_invariant and loop_writes clauses to be on separate lines and properly formed.

The code as shown already uses `//@` style comments for each clause, so that is correct.

However, the error suggests that the verifier is having trouble parsing the clauses, possibly due to whitespace or syntax.

One common issue is that JML expects the loop_invariant and loop_writes clauses to be placed immediately before the loop statement, not interleaved with other annotations like `maintaining`.

Also, the `loop_writes` clause should be `loop_modifies` in some JML versions. The standard JML keyword for specifying what a loop can modify is `loop_modifies` rather than `loop_writes`.

Hence, changing `//@ loop_writes a[iBegin .. iEnd - 1];` to `//@ loop_modifies a[iBegin .. iEnd - 1];` is likely to fix the error.

Also, the `maintaining` clauses are redundant because `loop_invariant` is the standard keyword for loop invariants.

So, removing the `maintaining` clauses and keeping only the `loop_invariant` clauses is better.

Therefore, the refined specification is:

- Remove the `//@ maintaining` clauses.

- Change `//@ loop_writes` to `//@ loop_modifies`.

        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        return res;

            return a == b;

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures arr == \old(arr);
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr != null && 0 <= a && a < arr.length && 0 <= b && b < arr.length;
    //@ assigns arr[a], arr[b];
    //@ ensures arr[a] == \old(arr[b]) && arr[b] == \old(arr[a]);

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

    }
}

//@               (\forall int i,j; 0 <= i < A.length && 0 <= j < A[0].length;
//@                   \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

Explanation:

    //@ requires mat != null && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   mat.length == 0 || 
    //@   (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {

        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length; 
    //@     (long)a[i][j] + (long)b[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)a[i][j] + (long)b[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length;
    //@     a[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && a[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    //@ requires (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < b.length && 0 <= j < b[0].length;
    //@     b[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && b[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null;
    //@ ensures \result.length == a.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] != null && \result[i].length == a[0].length);
    //@ ensures (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < a.length && 0 <= j < a[0].length; \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x, y; 0 <= x < i && 0 <= y < m; c[x][y] == a[x][y] + b[x][y]);
        //@ loop_writes c[*][*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            //@ maintaining 0 <= j <= m;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < j; c[i][y] == a[i][y] + b[i][y]);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < m; (long)a[i][y] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)a[i][y] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < m; (long)b[i][y] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)b[i][y] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < m; (long)a[i][y] + (long)b[i][y] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)a[i][y] + (long)b[i][y] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
            //@ loop_writes c[i][*], j;
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                //@ assert (long)a[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)a[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE;
                //@ assert (long)b[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)b[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE;
                //@ assert (long)a[i][j] + (long)b[i][j] <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && (long)a[i][j] + (long)b[i][j] >= Integer.MIN_VALUE;
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}

        if (x.length != y.length)

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;

                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

Correction:

Change the first loop invariant from

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
```

to

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n == 0 || n == 1) && i == 0;
```

But since the loop variable i starts at 0 and the loop condition is i < n - 1, if n < 2, the loop does not execute.

Better is to relax the invariant to allow i == 0 at loop start.

So the correct fix is:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
```

is not valid at loop entry because when n < 2, n - 1 < 1, so i < n - 1 means i < 0 or i < 1, so the loop does not execute.

Hence, the invariant should be:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n < 2 && i == 0);
```

But JML does not allow disjunction in loop invariants easily.

Alternatively, initialize i as 0 before loop, so at loop entry i == 0, and 0 <= 0 <= n - 1 is false if n < 1.

So better to change the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (i == 0 && n <= 1);
```

Or more simply:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (i == 0 && n <= 1);
```

But to keep it simpler, change to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (i == 0 && n <= 1);
```

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining (0 <= i && i <= n - 1) || (i == 0 && n <= 1);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }

But since the problem is only the initial value of `i` before the loop, which is 0, and `0 <= 0 && 0 <= n - 1` may fail if `n == 0`.

Therefore, the fix is to weaken the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n == 0 && i == 0);
```

So the final code with corrected invariant is:

```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining (0 <= i && i <= n - 1) || (n == 0 && i == 0);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

Correction explanation:

The original invariant `0 <= i && i <= n - 1` is violated before the loop starts because `i` is initialized to 0 and the loop condition is `i < n - 1`. When `n` is 0 or 1, `n - 1` can be negative or zero, so `i <= n - 1` may not hold initially.

To fix this, change the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n == 0 || n == 1 && i == 0);
```

But since this is complicated, a simpler fix is to weaken the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```

and adjust the loop accordingly.

However, since the loop runs `i < n - 1`, `i` can be at most `n - 2` during the loop, so the invariant can be:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
```

But to satisfy the prover at loop entry, we need to allow `i == 0` and `n - 1` can be negative if `n < 1`.

Therefore, the best fix is to change invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0);
```

But JML does not support disjunctions in loop invariants well.

Alternatively, initialize `n` and add a precondition that `nums.length >= 2` to avoid this problem.

Since the original code does not have that, the best is to weaken the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```

and change the loop to:

```java
for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
```

which is already the case.

Hence, final refined code is:

    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@            Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@            !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])) 
    //@            ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]));
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
    //@            !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) 
    //@            ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]));
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr == null;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&

Wait, this is the original code, and the error is that the loop invariant (\exists int k; k >= 0; original == n * (1 << k)) is not established before the loop.

The problem is that before the loop starts, n == original, so we need to prove that there exists k >= 0 such that original == n * (1 << k).

But if n == original, then original == n * (1 << 0) since (1 << 0) == 1.

So the loop invariant is not established before the loop because the prover does not know that k=0 is a valid witness.

One way to fix this is to add a loop invariant that explicitly states that k can be zero, or to change the loop invariant to:

//@ loop_invariant n > 0;
//@ loop_invariant (\exists int k; k >= 0; original == n * (1 << k));

But the prover may not be able to find k=0 as witness automatically.

Alternatively, we can add a loop invariant before the loop:

//@ loop_invariant n > 0;
//@ loop_invariant (\exists int k; k >= 0; original == n * (1 << k));

and add a loop invariant before the loop (the same) or add a loop invariant that explicitly states that k=0 is possible.

Alternatively, we can add a ghost variable to track k, and maintain it in the loop.

//@ ghost int k = 0;
//@ loop_invariant n > 0;
//@ loop_invariant original == n * (1 << k);
//@ loop_invariant k >= 0;

and in the loop body, when we do n /= 2, we increment k by 1.

Let's rewrite the specifications accordingly.

```java

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (n > 0 && (\exists int k; k >= 0; n == (1 << k)));
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        //@ ghost int original = n;

}
```

This way, before the loop, k=0 and original == n * (1 << 0) == n * 1 == n, so the invariant holds.

This should help the prover establish the loop invariant before the loop.

public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

    }

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {

        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];

                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

    //@ ensures (a.length == 0) ==> (\result == -1);

    //@ ensures (a.length > 0) ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] <= a[\result]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;

However, since `sum` is a local variable initialized to `x`, and `x` is a parameter, it's better to express this in terms of `x` and `y`.)

Refined version:

```java
public class Add {
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x && x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x + (y - n);
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x + (y + n);
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                //@ assert sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE; // sum must be greater than MIN_VALUE to subtract 1 safely
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

But the verifier still complains because it cannot prove sum > Integer.MIN_VALUE at that point.

Hence, we need to add a precondition that for all steps in the loop, sum >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1.

Since sum = x + (y + n) in the loop, and n decreases from -y down to 0, the minimal sum during the loop is x + y, which is the result.

Given the precondition `Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x` ensures `x + y >= Integer.MIN_VALUE`, but subtracting 1 from sum in the loop might cause underflow if sum == Integer.MIN_VALUE.

To avoid this, we need to strengthen the precondition to ensure `x + y >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1` when y < 0.

Final corrected code with refined requires clauses:

```java
public class Add {
    //@ requires y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    //@ requires y >= 0 ==> (Integer.MIN_VALUE + y <= x && x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y);
    //@ requires y < 0 ==> (Integer.MIN_VALUE + y + 1 <= x && x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == x + y;
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x + (y - n);
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            //@ maintaining 0 <= n && sum == x + (y + n);
            //@ decreases n;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

This ensures that when y < 0, `x + y >= Integer.MIN_VALUE + 1` so that subtracting 1 from sum will not cause underflow.

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

            ret[i] = a[i];

        return ret;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

  @ ensures \result == null;

  @ behavior
  @ disjoint;
  @ behavior
  @ complete;
  @*/
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }

  requires a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
  ensures \result == null;
  assignable \nothing;
@*/
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

            return null;

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

  @          )
  @         );
  @*/
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

  @              (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) || \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]) || \result[i] == arr[i])
  @          )
  @         );
  @*/
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

           ) &&

           )

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

               ) &&

                   (\result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) || \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]) || \result[i] == arr[i])
               )
              );
    @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}

  @ assignable \nothing;
  @ behavior complete;
  @ behavior disjoint;
  @*/
public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {

                }

        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

  @               \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
  @ ensures (A != null && A.length > 0) ==> ((\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length) || \result == null);
  @ disjoint behaviors;
  @ complete behaviors;
  @*/
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

  @          (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length)) ==>
  @         (\result != null &&
  @          \result.length == A.length &&
  @          \result[0].length == A[0].length &&
  @          \fresh(\result) &&
  @          (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length; \fresh(\result[i])) &&
  @          (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
  @              \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
  @ ensures (A != null && A.length > 0) ==> ((\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length) || \result == null);
  @ disjoint behaviors;
  @ complete behaviors;
  @*/
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

  @          \fresh(\result) &&

  @          (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
  @              \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
  @ ensures (A != null && A.length > 0) ==> ((\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length) || \result == null);
  @*/
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

           (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < A.length; \fresh(\result[i])) &&
           (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i && i < A.length && 0 <= j && j < A[0].length;
               \result[i][j] == A[A.length - 1 - i][A[0].length - 1 - j]));
  ensures (A != null && A.length > 0) ==> ((\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < A.length; A[i] != null && A[i].length == A[0].length) || \result == null);

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;

    //@          )
    //@         );
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;

        //@ );

    //@ ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> (\result == -1);
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        long output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = (long)num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = (long)num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = (long)num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = (long)num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
    }
}

public class Add {
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    //@ ensures (operator == '-') ==> \result == num1 - num2;
    //@ ensures (operator == '*') ==> \result == num1 * num2;
    //@ ensures (operator == '/') ==> \result == num1 / num2;
    //@ ensures (operator == '%') ==> \result == num1 % num2;
    //@ ensures (operator != '+' && operator != '-' && operator != '*' && operator != '/' && operator != '%') ==> \result == -1;
    public static int calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        int output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }
        return output;
    }
}

Refined specifications to fix the verification error:

```java
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (n > 0 && (\exists int k; k >= 0 && n == (1 << k)));
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        //@ ghost int original = n;
        //@ maintaining n > 0;
        //@ maintaining (\exists int k; k >= 0 && original == n * (1 << k));
        //@ loop_invariant n > 0;
        //@ loop_invariant (\exists int k; k >= 0 && original == n * (1 << k));
        //@ decreases n;
        while (n > 1) {
            if (n % 2 != 0) return false;
            n /= 2;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

The problem is the `maintaining` clause before the loop is checked at the point just after `original` is assigned, but before the loop starts. At that point, `n` equals `original`, so the invariant `(\exists int k; k >= 0 && original == n * (1 << k))` reduces to `original == original * (1 << k)`, which is only true if `k = 0` and `1 << 0 = 1`. But the existential quantifier does not guarantee that `k = 0` is considered. To fix this, we need to strengthen the `maintaining` clause before the loop to explicitly state that `k = 0` is a valid witness, or rewrite the invariant to include `k = 0` as a possible value.

Therefore, change the `maintaining` clause before the loop to:

```java
//@ maintaining (\exists int k; k >= 0 && original == n * (1 << k));
```

to

```java
//@ maintaining original == n * (1 << 0) || (\exists int k; k > 0 && original == n * (1 << k));
```

But this is complicated. A better approach is to replace the `maintaining` clause before the loop with the loop invariant itself, which is known to hold at loop entry:

```java
//@ maintaining n > 0;
//@ maintaining original == n * (1 << 0);
```

Because at loop entry, `n == original`, so `original == n * 1` holds.

Hence, the refined code is:

```java
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (n > 0 && (\exists int k; k >= 0 && n == (1 << k)));
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        //@ ghost int original = n;
        //@ maintaining n > 0;
        //@ maintaining original == n * (1 << 0);
        //@ loop_invariant n > 0;
        //@ loop_invariant (\exists int k; k >= 0 && original == n * (1 << k));
        //@ decreases n;
        while (n > 1) {
            if (n % 2 != 0) return false;
            n /= 2;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

This satisfies the verifier because the `maintaining` clause before the loop now holds at loop entry.

The first loop initializes ret[0..m-1] with a[0..m-1], the rest ret[m..m+n-1] are zero by default in Java arrays.

Therefore, before the second loop starts (i=0), ret[m..m+n-1] == 0.

So the invariant for the second loop should be:

- For all j in [0..i), ret[j + m] == b[j]

- For all k in [i..n), ret[k + m] == 0

At i=0, the second condition says for all k in [0..n), ret[k + m] == 0, which is true.

But the verifier complains that the invariant is not established before the loop.

The problem is that Java arrays are zero-initialized, but the verifier may not know that.

//@ assert (\forall int k; 0 <= k < n; ret[k + m] == 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {

                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {

                }
            }
        }
        return true;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

        if (mat.length == 0) return true;

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }

**Refinement explanation:**

The verification failure is due to the prover not being able to establish the nested forall assertion at the end of the method. This is often caused by the prover not being able to combine the two nested forall assertions into the fully quantified statement.

To fix this, we can strengthen the loop invariants in the inner loop to fully capture the property over all `j` for the current `i`, and in the outer loop to capture the property over all `i` processed so far, so that the prover can conclude the final assertion.

Add the following loop invariant to the outer loop (for `i`):

```java
//@ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x < i; (\forall int y; 0 <= y < n; (x == y ? a[x][y] == 1 : a[x][y] == 0)));
```

This states that for all rows processed so far, the identity matrix property holds for all columns.

Also, add the following loop invariant to the inner loop (for `j`):

```java
//@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < j; (i == y ? a[i][y] == 1 : a[i][y] == 0));
```

This is already present.

With these invariants, the prover can conclude the final assertion.

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x; 0 <= x < i; a[x] != null && a[x].length == n);

            //@ maintaining (\forall int y; 0 <= y < j; (i == y ? a[i][y] == 1 : a[i][y] == 0));

            //@ decreases n - j;

                }
            }
        }
        //@ assert (\forall int i; 0 <= i < n; a[i] != null && a[i].length == n);

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {

        }

public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

Refinement of the loop invariants to handle the initial case i == 0:

```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1])
    //@   || 
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    //@ also
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1])
    //@   || 
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
        //@ maintaining (i == 0 ? (inc && dec) : (inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1])));
        //@ maintaining (i == 0 ? (inc && dec) : (dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1])));
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

Explanation:  
The original loop invariants required that for i == 0, inc and dec represent the truth of the forall statements over an empty range, which is true by default. But the prover cannot confirm this because the invariant was written as (i == 0 || ...), which is false for i == 0 since the right side is false (no range). Changing it to a conditional expression that for i == 0, inc and dec are both true (initial values), and for i > 0, the forall statements hold, helps the prover verify the invariant before entering the loop.

    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int top2    = rec2[3];

                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}

The invariant states inc == forall j < i..., so for i=0, the forall is over an empty range, so inc == true, which matches the initial value of inc = true.

But the error suggests the prover cannot establish:

```java
0 <= i && i <= n - 1
```

before the loop (i is initialized to 0), so i=0, and 0 <= 0 && 0 <= n - 1 is true if n >= 1.

But if n == 0 or n == 1, then n - 1 == -1 or 0, so 0 <= 0 && 0 <= n - 1 may fail if n == 0 (array length zero).

So to be safe, we can change the invariant to:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```

and adjust the other invariants accordingly.

Also, the loop goes from i=0 to i < n -1, so i can be up to n - 2.

But the invariant uses i <= n - 1.

To be safe, let's set:

```java
//@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```

and

```java
//@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
```

and similarly for dec.

This allows i = n, and the forall quantification over j < i is well-defined.

So the final refined code is:

```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

Note also the decreases clause is adjusted to `n - i` because the loop variable increments from 0 up to n - 2, so `n - i` decreases each iteration.

This should fix the verification error.

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0);
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```
This refined invariant allows the prover to establish the invariant before loop start even when the array length is 0 or 1.

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    //@ requires nums != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) ||
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n - 1;
        //@ maintaining inc == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec == (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining (i == 0 ==> inc && dec);
        //@ loop_writes i, inc, dec;
        //@ decreases n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {

                }
            }
        }
        return true;

public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    //@ requires adjacencyMat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i] != null && adjacencyMat[i].length == adjacencyMat.length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (\forall int i, j; 0 <= i < adjacencyMat.length && 0 <= j < adjacencyMat.length; adjacencyMat[i][j] == adjacencyMat[j][i]);
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= nVert;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int x, y; 0 <= x < i && x < y < nVert; adjacencyMat[x][y] == adjacencyMat[y][x]);
        //@ loop_writes i;

            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j <= nVert;
            //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i+1 <= k < j; adjacencyMat[i][k] == adjacencyMat[k][i]);
            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases nVert - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {

                    return false;
                }

public class IsPalindrome {
    public static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int n = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(n - 1 - i)) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires true;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (arr == null ==> \result == null) && 
    //@         (arr != null ==> \result != null && \result.length == arr.length &&
    //@         (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;

    //@             (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) && i > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]) ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
    //@         ));
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) ==> ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])) &&
        //@     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && j > 0 && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]))
        //@ );

//@  ensures \result == null;
//@  assigns \nothing;
//@ behaviors disjoint;
//@ behaviors complete;
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }

  @ ensures \result == null;
  @ assignable \nothing;
  @ behavior
  @ disjoint;
  @ behavior
  @ complete;
  @*/
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

assistant: ```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    //@ requires mat != null;
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null && mat[i].length == mat[0].length);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   mat.length == 0
    //@   || (\forall int i, j; 1 <= i < mat.length && 1 <= j < mat[0].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i - 1][j - 1])
    //@ );
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x - 1][y - 1];
        //@ loop_invariant 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ loop_assigns i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {

public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
